title: Mixed Event — Never Give Up Cooking! — Episode3 A Reliable Teacher?

meta.Event Outline: Tsukasa and Saki invite Toya over for a party. With White Day approaching, he wants to give something back to the two of them. He tries his hand at baking from scratch, with varying results...

rows.Line: Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Hmm... There really are quite a lot of recipes for making homemade snacks and sweets.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Hopefully, I can find one that's not too difficult, but it also needs to be something Tsukasa and Saki will enjoy...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Come to think of it...
What kinds of sweets do they actually like...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I vaguely remember going over to their house this one time and...)

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Excellent. They've turned out nicely.
Kids, the cupcakes are ready. Would you all like some...?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: I made them not too sweet just for you, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Wow! They look so yummy...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Mrs. Tenma baked a lot for us.
All of them were delicious, and Saki and Tsukasa also seemed to enjoy them very much...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Cupcakes...
Yes, that seems like a beginner-friendly option.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, I'll give it a try when I get home from school tomorrow.
The next day
Aoyagi Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Okay, I've bought everything the recipe said I'll need...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Seeing them all laid out like this... There really are a lot of ingredients involved. And I'm apparently going to need all of them to make my cupcakes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Will I actually be able to...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, I don't have time for that.
I need to just give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(The recipe says...
“Soft and fluffy chiffon cupcakes that anyone can make!”)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This may be easy for others, but I'm someone who hadn't used a kitchen knife until very recently.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (So, I'll need to proceed carefully without letting my guard down...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: First, place some eggs and sugar in this bowl... No, wait, just the egg whites... How do I do that...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I see! You can use half of a shell to separate out the yolk from the whites.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hang on... Use half of a shell...to separate out the yolk...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I understand what it says...
But my mind doesn't seem to think that's possible...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Th-There... I cracked it in half...!
Now to use this to separate out...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: N-No...! The yolk split in half... And what's left is... There's no way I'll be able to get just the whites out...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay... I'll try that again...
se_event_cooking_2023_002

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This says you make something called a “meringue” by beating the egg whites...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(But for how long...?
Will this really turn out as fluffy as what's in the photo for this recipe...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I don't know, but I'll just have to keep beating...)
se_event_cooking_2023_002

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay, the meringue's done.
Next is...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What...? I'm supposed to place the meringue in the bowl of yolks and mix them together...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Just how much mixing is this going to make me do...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: All that's left is to let them bake...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Also, that took up quite a lot of my time. This recipe suggested that it wouldn't take so long...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(And the kitchen's become a mess...
I should clean everything up before Mom and Dad get home.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I followed the recipe as closely as I could, but I'm really not sure how they're going to turn out...)
se_event_cooking_2023_005

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I guess they're done.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This looks...completely different from the photo in the recipe... They look considerably flatter. Squished even...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Where did I go wrong?
No, I should taste them before making any conclusions...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Here goes nothing...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: *Grimace*

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(It tastes sweet like some kind of cake...
But this texture... It's terrible. I feel like I'm eating paste...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The recipe said that these should turn out soft and fluffy...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I know sweets aren't exactly my favorite thing... But more to the point, these cupcakes...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (They taste awful...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Maybe I aimed too high...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (No, wait...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I can have someone teach me.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (MEIKO and KAITO know how to cook and bake very well...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (As busy as they are, my hands are tied. I have no choice but to ask them for their help...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I know it's getting late, but I think I'll go over to see them now...
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Welcome.
Hm? Toya? Are you by yourself today...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, for a personal matter.
Is it just you here, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, are you looking for someone?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was hoping to speak with MEIKO and KAITO, but I guess they're not here at the moment...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
They're both gone right now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: KAITO's practicing with Rin and Len, while MEIKO just left to deliver some food she'd made for them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, I'm watching the cafe while she's out.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mind if I ask what you were hoping to talk to them about? If you like, I can tell them later for you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I can just come back tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you say so...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But... Don't hesitate to ask if there is something on your mind. I want to help you in any way I can, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, if you don't mind listening...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. Which is why you want to learn how to bake something special for White Day...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Toya, you don't have much experience cooking, do you?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. When I tried on my own, things didn't go so well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, that did show me more or less what I am and am not able to handle.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So it wasn't all a waste. That's good.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Anyway... You're hoping to make some cupcakes, yes? That should be on the easy side in terms of baked treats. At least, I think I remember MEIKO saying something like that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, the recipe I found also said it was “beginner-friendly”.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. Then, that means I could also make them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait, Miku, you know how to bake?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I've never made cupcakes before, but I think I can since I've been helping MEIKO cook on a regular basis...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I was going to ask MEIKO and KAITO for some advice, but I didn't know Miku could also cook.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (MEIKO usually has her hands full running the cafe, and KAITO tends to be busy being Len's teacher...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (On the other hand, if Miku does know how to cook... I may be causing her a bit of trouble, but it may be worth asking her instead.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Miku, if possible...
Would you mind teaching me how to bake cupcakes?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sure, I'd be more than happy to.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you. I really appreciate it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, when would you like to make them? Also, where?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sure MEIKO will let us use the kitchen if we ask her.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. But it's already getting late, so tomorrow after school may be best...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Also, where...? It would be nice to be able to use this cafe's kitchen...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But she just lent it out to KAITO and Len. Knowing that, I sort of feel bad about asking her to let us borrow it...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Why don't we make them at my house...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sounds good. I should be able to teach you as long you have your phone out.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, I'll head over tomorrow. See you then.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you, Miku.
